name: domain.network_forensics
description: Network traffic metadata analyzer, TLS cert inspector, tri-state port security auditor, and 7-layer fault isolation engine

entrypoints.name: audit_port_configuration
entrypoints.description: Audit open ports and exposed network services against security best practices

parameters.name: open_ports
parameters.description: List of port numbers or objects ({'port': 22, 'service': 'ssh'})

entrypoints.name: analyze_packet_summary
entrypoints.description: Analyze network flows (IP source/dest, protocol, packet sizes, flags) for port scans and DDoS signatures

entrypoints.name: inspect_tls_certificate
entrypoints.description: Validate TLS/SSL certificate metadata (issuer, expiration, cipher suites)

entrypoints.name: analyze_traceroute_hops
entrypoints.description: Parse traceroute output, identify intermediate TTL-decrementing hops, and detect latency anomalies or routing loops

parameters.name: raw_output
parameters.description: Raw text output from traceroute or tracert utility

entrypoints.name: evaluate_port_states
entrypoints.description: Classify port scan findings into tri-state reachability: open (SYN/ACK), closed (RST), or filtered (drop/timeout)

entrypoints.name: decode_tcp_flags
entrypoints.description: Decode hexadecimal TCP flags, evaluate handshake semantics, and detect scan evasion signatures (Null, Xmas, SYN-FIN)

entrypoints.name: classify_cleartext_exposure
entrypoints.description: Evaluate cleartext protocol exposure risk and unencrypted credential vulnerabilities for HTTP, Telnet, FTP, etc.

entrypoints.name: run_7layer_diagnostic_chain
entrypoints.description: Execute systematic 7-layer network fault isolation chain from physical to application layer

entrypoints.name: calculate_subnet_geometry
entrypoints.description: Calculate bitwise network address, broadcast address, and host capacity for an IPv4 CIDR prefix

entrypoints.name: generate_visual_brief
entrypoints.description: Generate interactive HTML visual brief with Mermaid diagrams in %TEMP%

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Optional file path destination for the HTML brief
